Brightpath Foundation | Research Engineer (Speech AI/ML) | Remote (worldwide)

Brightpath Foundation connects philanthropists with innovators working on hard problems. Its engineering hub supports grant-funded education technology projects that improve early reading.

We are looking for an expert in modern voice AI. Partner teams build tools that assess early reading from children's speech in real classrooms: noisy rooms, young voices and high stakes for fairness.

We are looking for folks who:

- have built and operated production speech recognition or speech-processing systems

- know the data-to-model pipeline: collection, annotation, fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment

- can speak the languages of both research and engineering

If this sounds like you, please apply: https://www.brightpath.example.test/careers
